game: ARI @ SEA, 2025-11-09 16:05 ET, SEA -7, total 44.5, outdoors

script.base: Seattle leads by halftime in a moderate outdoor 44.5 game (implied SEA 25.8 / ARI 18.8). They build it through JSN, who has taken 36 of about 74 Seattle targets over weeks 6-7-9, then lean Walker (38 carries) and Charbonnet (32) late. Arizona trails as a 7-point dog, so Brissett throws and McBride (33 targets, 201 yards in those three games) is the safety valve; Knight's 11-carry role does not control the script against a Seattle run defense at 3.58 YPC.
script.flip1: Seattle is up 14+ early, salts it with Walker and Charbonnet, and JSN's receiving yards stall in the 90s while Arizona abandons the run so Knight and Carter rush lines die and garbage targets pile onto McBride and Harrison.
script.flip2: Arizona's missing corners keep it a pass-first game that stays within one score: both teams throw late, JSN and McBride clear, and Walker never gets the late carry spike because Seattle does not need to run the clock.
